method: Manual accessibility UI actions using a separate Release app and normal Cmd-Q exits; saved preference assertions are programmatic.
environment: Apple M4, macOS 27.2 (26B123), Xcode 27.1 (27A9275), arm64, signing disabled.
isolation: Unique temporary app bundle identifier; qualification temporary library and qualification preferences; no tracks or playback.
